capabilities: Export current search results to a PDF report
Detect and rank shared frontmatter properties and tags for the summary table
List unchecked tasks from each matching note
Link summary rows and cross-references to internal PDF chapters
Paginate notes onto A4 pages with headers and footers
extras: Bilingual English/Spanish interface; the README also documents a Python bundler for building and deploying without Node.js.
problem: Search results live only inside Obsidian, so there is no printable, navigable document to hand to someone else.
summary: Exports the current Obsidian search results to a styled A4 PDF report with a shared-property summary table, open tasks, and linked note chapters.
